description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Priest of Fell Rites.
Activate Priest of Fell Rites by paying three life, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Activated Sleeper from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Priest of Fell Rites.
When Activated Sleeper enters the battlefield, Righteous Valkyrie's first ability triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Activated Sleeper's toughness.
